## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue or OpenSpec change when relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish mock tests, native flow checks and remote CI. Explain any relevant check that did not run.

## Behavior and limits

For lifecycle changes, address cancellation, missing readings, storage failure, concurrency, reload and uncertain delivery. State any compatibility or integration limitations and update the documentation accordingly.
